title: laptop-vpn connection
description: How `vpn on` connects. The relay password is not here: it lives in the macOS Keychain (service vpnuser-relay); `vpn forget` clears it. Apply with: vpn apply (reconnects if the tunnel is up).

relay.description: The SSH relay on relay that forwards to the egress box (docs/PHONE-VPN.md).

user.description: The account on the egress box (phone_vpn_user).

local_socks_port.description: Where the local SOCKS proxy listens; the system proxy points here.

router.description: When enabled, vpn-router owns the local SOCKS port and SSH uses upstream_port. Both router ports must differ from local_socks_port and from each other.

keepalive.description: A dead connection is noticed after interval_seconds × max_missed and redialled.

reconnect_delay_seconds.description: Pause before redialling after the tunnel drops.

ciphers.description: SSH ciphers, in order of preference.

_guide.description: How to write this file. Kept up to date by `vpn` itself — edits here are overwritten.
